data.narrative:
Alpha School is a Series A AI & Software company founded by MacKenzie Price and Brian Holtz. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), with the peer set including Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, and Black Forest Labs.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach for this stage and sector. The analysis examines 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers with valuations ranging from $3.2B (Black Forest Labs, Series B) to $29.0B (Scale AI, Series B), yielding a median of $15.3B. This method captures material dispersion within the frontier-tech AI landscape, reflecting variance in maturity and market positioning across Series A and B stages.

The triangulated valuation range is $13.0B to $17.6B, with a median of $15.3B. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single method and limited data points; key uncertainties center on Alpha School's relative position within the peer set on revenue traction, technical differentiation, and capital efficiency. The peer range of $3.2B–$29.0B underscores the volatility in private AI valuations at this stage. Additional methods such as DCF or revenue multiple analysis would require financial performance data not available in the current dataset.
